notes.title: 🍄 PATCH 1.03 🍄
notes.notes:
Welcome to the second public patch update for the full game!

In this patch, we're focusing mainly on the first few minutes of gameplay, assisting new players and smoothing out some difficulty edges based on preliminary feedback. We're also improving some weapons and boosting Nero's moving speed.

This is an incremental process, so expect more updates soon!

[Gameplay changes]

 Removed the first wave of flying Crazy Skulls after a few seconds in the Dark Age.
 Rats and Skeletons are less likely to anticipate your path (i.e., they are now dumber, as you would expect from rats and brainless skeletons).
 Rat speed reduced by 40%.
 Skull speed reduced by 10%.
 Griffon: reduced HP and damage by 20%.
 Boomerang weapon: improved targeting direction (now points exactly at the nearest enemy).
 Yo-yo weapon: 50% higher base crit chance, can now steal 1 HP per crit hit, and gets momentarily bigger on a crit hit.
 Mosquito: reduced damage by 50%.
 Pyramid Boss: reduced HP by 20%.
 Tutankamhon Boss: fixes, rebalanced, and visually improved.
 Nero base move speed boosted from 70 to 80.

[QoL]

 Fixed: Chrono Forge not showing "BUY" when appropriate.
 Fixed: Yo-Yo icon is blurred on some systems.
 Clearer descriptions for Yo-Yo and Red Leech weapons.
 Clarified some unlock descriptions.
 Removed "Available in next run" text.
 Dummy enemy in the Sandbox now has 1,000,000 HP (don't worry about hitting him, he doesn't feel anything).


Check out this quick guide for beginners and advanced players
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3142026192

Thank you for playing our game
- Cris, DDT, Lele 🌙🌶️  (Lunar Chili team)

notes.title: 🍄 Release Date Announcement 🍄
notes.notes:
Hey fellow gamers,
We're just weeks away from a big day for us – the launch of Time Survivors on January 15, 2024.

Mark Your Calendars: January 15th, 2024!

The past 13 months have been a wild ride of coding marathons, intense playtests, and lively discussions – all fueled by our passion as a three-person indie team.

Time Survivors is more than a game; it's our heart and soul poured into pixels. We're thrilled to share it with you on Windows PC for $4.99. Plus, as a thank you to our early supporters, enjoy a 20% off launch discount.

[previewyoutube=jScUZqv9Flc;full][/previewyoutube]A glimpse of the new Ice Age stage - still WiP! Can you spot the character - a troubled painter with a cap?

Get ready for a content-rich experience: 5 stages, 12 historical characters with unique skills, 93 different enemies, 50+ weapons and items, along with Cursed Relics, unlockables, and hidden gems to uncover.

We've poured our hearts into Time Survivors, hoping to give you a game that's both challenging and a blast to play. We can’t wait for you to dive into the different eras, unravel the story, and maybe even find yourself attached to our quirky cast of characters.

notes.title: 🍄 Release Date Reveal 🍄
notes.notes:
Embark on a time-traveling adventure in Time Survivors: Chapter 0, arriving on September 18th!

"The Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike Ever Made" (our game 😊) offers a rogue-like bullet hell experience, starring iconic historical figures like Abe Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra, and more. 

Each character boasts a one-of-a-kind ability that transforms every playthrough. For example, here's Nikola Tesla's electrifying electrodes, to create shocking paths that zap your enemies.

[previewyoutube=zKJ3ooa92Xk;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, Oda Nobunaga can morph into a flying ninja robot, and Abe Lincoln can summon defensive barriers crafted from cherry trees. With 8 characters in Chapter 0, each wielding their own distinctive ability, we believe there's plenty to explore.

But that's not all! We've also introduced a tree-based meta progression system. As a small indie team, we've poured our hearts into this feature, allowing you to unlock and enhance characters, abilities, weapons, items, and stages by using resources like Guardian Hearts, Damascus Steel and Time Crystals.

Tailor your progression to your playstyle, strategically allocating resources to craft your unique build.

[previewyoutube=RfX-EhPE9C8;full][/previewyoutube]

Join our Discord community to connect directly with us, share your thoughts, and offer suggestions. We're committed to continuous improvement and growth, and your input means the world to us.

We're working hard to finalize the last details. In just 12 days, the game will be released, and you'll have the chance to dive into the story of Time Survivors: Chapter 0. Wishlist the game now to stay in the loop.

Warm regards,
- Cris, DDT, Lele (Lunar Chili Team)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455500/Time_Survivors_Chapter_0/

PATCH NOTES 0.601 (10447619)
[Gameplay changes]

 Overdrive powerup now even stronger: 2x ammo, 2x weapon speed, 4x the fun
 Slightly nerfed the waves at minute 4 (reduced the number of enemies by ~10%)
 Weapons projectiles are now destroyed when outside of the screen area
 Boomerang ending speed is now capped
 Mushroom effect ends at end of character shrinking, not at the beginning (yeah we died too trying to stomp the Imps)
 Fixed global fire bugs (frequency and homing)
 Changed Dark Mage fire interval to compensate global fire bugs
 Giant mushroom weapon area does not scale with Telescope anymore
 Revised the algorithm for object rarity: now objets should spawn from breakable as we intended from the beginning, ie more often ;)


[UI improvements]

 Added arrows and controller support in Levelup (press A to confirm choice).
 Added support for Controller DPAD (in UI and in game).
 Added controller support in Main Menu (other out-of-game menus not yet supported).
 Player health bar now hidden on gameover and endstage
 Improved enemy bullets color
 Removed embedded UI navigation (caused de-sync in selections).
 Tentative fix for bug: "On some Intel laptops, the game opens with a warning popup"
 Fixed refund bug (savegame not performed resulting in nop after a new run).
 Fixed Sling unlock numerator.
